negatives.claim: GENERator-1.2B-prokaryote used ZERO-SHOT at default sampling, with no fine-tuning, is more detectable than a 3-mer Markov baseline on the distinguishability falsifier
negatives.scope: GENERator-1.2B-prokaryote ONLY, at DEFAULT sampling, ZERO-SHOT with NO fine-tuning, scored by distinguishability against a 3-mer Markov chain on E. coli promoter windows. This is STAGE 1 of a 3-stage recipe used ALONE; stages 2-3 (functional + perturbational supervision) were never run.
negatives.revival_condition: any fine-tuned checkpoint of a prokaryote DNA LM scored on the same distinguishability falsifier -- which IS family G-D, already planned
negatives.claim_corrected_from: Self-supervised DNA pretraining followed by functional supervision improves a bacterial promoter generator (AlphaGenome-discussion proposal #12)
negatives.claim_correction_reason: 2026-10-09 peer review: the SCOPE was narrow but the CLAIM named the whole class, and the claim is what a future search matches against, so the over-broad foreclosure survived the original re-scoping

negatives.claim: A 13,217-parameter 3-width (6/20/75) conv encoder over 150 bp peak tiles beats a single GC feature on genomic promoter-tile activity
negatives.scope: A 13,217-parameter conv at THREE kernel widths (6/20/75) over 150 bp peak tiles -- ~1 decade of range. The proposal specifies 1 bp/16 bp/128 bp/1 kb/10 kb over 1 Mb (FOUR decades), which a 150 bp tile cannot host at all, so the proposed arm is UNRUNNABLE on this substrate rather than merely unrun.
negatives.revival_condition: the 4-decade pyramid is run on a substrate with >=3 decades of available range (a longer genomic window, or a constructed eukaryotic/human panel)

negatives.claim: BLOSUM62 and ESM2-650M likelihood both rank the resistant residue as benign at catalogued target sites in HIV-1 RT, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro and fungal ERG11/FKS1
negatives.scope: PATHOGEN TARGET-SITE resistance systems ONLY -- three pathogens, catalogued resistance positions, scored by mid-rank of the resistant residue among the 19 alternatives (pooled 4.5 of 19 vs a null of 10.0, n=139). DRM sites sit at ESM entropy percentile 0.494, i.e. exactly average, which REFUTES the usual 'the site is poorly conserved' account. Friedman 2013 (PLOS ONE 8:e82059) supplies a COUNTEREXAMPLE CLASS: EGFR and ALK resistance mutations tend to be RADICAL, so this must not be stated as a general law.
negatives.revival_condition: a conservation- or likelihood-keyed scorer is tested on a resistance system OUTSIDE pathogen target sites (e.g. kinase-inhibitor resistance), where the published counterexample class lives
